name: Ragdoll Gladiator Arena
desc:
⚔️ Step into the pit and take on a whole arena of ragdoll gladiators!

Every swing is real physics. Punch in full combos, wind up a crushing haymaker, slash and stab with your weapon, smash shields apart, and grab gladiators to drag them around or hurl them into each other. Every hit lands exactly where you aim.

🗡️ 60+ weapons, throwables and god powers: swords, spears, clubs, bows, javelins, fire pots, Thunderbolt, Meteor, Black Hole and more
🏛️ Gladiators who block, parry and fight back, plus rare bosses: Zeus, Poseidon, Hades and Caesar
🔥 Arena traps: spike walls, a spike pit, fire and a swinging blade
🐢 Slow motion for big finishers
🧪 Sandbox: spawn any gladiator, change gravity, make giants
🎁 Daily rewards and unlocks earned by knocking gladiators out

Play in first or third person on PC, phone, tablet or controller.

Can you master the pit?
